title: Bulk status is a mode in the actions menu, between Cycle count and Export
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. You hold the "Part Library & Inventory - Delete" permission (needed to change status/tracking).
custom_steps:
1. On the Active tab, open the Inventory actions menu (the three-dot button in the toolbar that holds Cycle count and Export).
  2. Read the bulk-status entry and where it sits.
  3. Switch to the Inactive tab and read the entry again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Bulk deactivation is a mode turned on from the Inventory actions menu (the three-dot toolbar button that already holds Cycle count and Export).
  • The entry reads "Deactivate parts" on the Active tab and "Activate parts" on the Inactive tab - one entry, never both, sitting between Cycle count and Export.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 2 (Deactivate parts); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R1: “Bulk deactivation is a mode. The user turns it on from the Inventory actions menu, the three-dot button in the toolbar that already holds Cycle count and Export.”
  • S2-R2: “That menu entry reads "Deactivate parts" while the Active tab is showing and "Activate parts" while the Inactive tab is showing. It is one entry, never both, and it sits between Cycle count and Export.”
